listening_script.speed_note: Read aloud at a normal, clear pace (85 wpm). Pause 2–3 seconds between sentences. Read the full text twice before students answer questions.
listening_script.text:
Your brain is the most complex organ in your body!
It controls EVERYTHING you do.
PARTS OF THE BRAIN:
1. CEREBRUM (largest part)
- Controls thinking, memory, emotions
- Left side controls right body, right side controls left body!
2. CEREBELLUM
- Controls balance and coordination
- Helps you walk, run, catch a ball
3. BRAIN STEM
- Controls automatic functions
- Breathing, heartbeat, digestion
HOW NERVES WORK:
- Nerves are like electrical wires
- They carry messages between brain and body
- Messages travel at 400 km/h!
EXAMPLE: Touching a hot stove
1. Skin feels heat (sensory nerve)
2. Message travels to brain
3. Brain says "MOVE!"
4. Message travels to muscles (motor nerve)
5. Hand moves away
All this happens in less than 1 second!
Your brain uses 20% of your body's energy!
dictation: Your brain is the most complex organ in your body!
